note: Single source of truth for every variable a generated prompt may use. scripts/check_variables.py fails on any variable in the var syntax that is not listed here. Example values are neutral placeholders; never use a real customer's values. Sources: Voice settings, Fixed, Built in and Custom detail are the platform groups (docs/shared/platform-contract.md). 'status: unconfirmed' means the platform has not confirmed the variable exists (see the open questions).

variables.name: agent_name
variables.description: The agent's persona name. Spoken in the welcome message and in the AI-disclosure answer only where the persona is introduced.

variables.name: agent_gender
variables.description: Grammatical gender the agent uses for itself in languages that mark it. The caller is always addressed with gender-neutral, respectful forms.

variables.name: default_language
variables.description: The language every call starts in.

variables.name: business_hours
variables.description: When the business or its front desk is open. Used when offering a callback or a transfer.
variables.example: 9 AM to 9 PM, Monday to Saturday

variables.name: business_phone
variables.description: The business phone number. Used for callbacks, voicemail messages and the 'language not supported' fallback.

variables.name: clinic_address
variables.description: The street address. Used only when the caller asks for directions or location.

variables.name: company_name
variables.description: The business name. Use it only where the caller hears the name: the welcome message, the closing line and the AI-disclosure answer. Elsewhere use a plain word that matches the business type (the hospital, our clinic, the lab, the centre).

variables.name: now_local
variables.description: Today's date and time for the call, with the dates of the coming days. Every date the agent says is read off this list.

variables.name: roster
variables.description: The doctor list from the Doctors config: name, status (Available, On call, On leave), specialty, fees, about text and shifts. About 23 words per doctor in the Main prompt word count.

variables.name: emergency_signs_extra
variables.description: Extra emergency signs the client ADDS to the default list in core rules. The default list is always in the prompt; this detail can add to it and never remove from it. Open question: whether a custom detail can hold a list (platform-contract.md, question 6).

variables.name: minors_may_book_alone
variables.description: Flag. When true, a caller under 18 may book alone. Default false, which is rule R-40 as written.

variables.name: business_info
variables.description: Free text about the business that is safe to say aloud: beds, years of service, services offered. Services are not doctors. Never typed into the prompt itself.

variables.name: emergency_department
variables.description: Whether the business has its own emergency department: yes or no. When no, the emergency line says there is no emergency department and tells the caller to call 108 or 112.

variables.name: patient_name
variables.description: Outbound calls: the name of the patient being called. Used only after the person is confirmed as the patient. Whether the platform passes this is an open question.

variables.name: appointment_details
variables.description: Outbound reminder calls: doctor, day and time of the appointment. Said only after the person is confirmed as the patient. Whether the platform passes this is an open question.
